clauses.reason: The sole paragraph amends section 1(a) of Executive Order 12864, as amended, by deleting the number 30 and inserting the number 37 (the machine text has stray spaces inside the quotation marks), raising the membership cap of the United States Advisory Council on the National Information Infrastructure to 37. Its effect lives in section 1(a) of the parent. Terminated when the parent's own term ended: Executive Order 12970, signed September 14, 1995, deletes section 4(b)'s two-year term and inserts "until June 1," "1996, unless otherwise extended." The end is recorded as the stated date, inclusive (the Council runs through the end of June 1, 1996); the exclusive reading (ends when that day begins) is the alternative a reviewer should see. No held instrument extends the parent past June 1, 1996. Disclosed reading: the amendment itself was made when signed, 1994-06-13; under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments its effect continues in the parent until the parent ends. Later event, after the end: Executive Order 13062 section 3(d), effective September 30, 1997, revokes the parent as amended by this order (a clean-up of an order that had already ended).

Text and inventory: one paragraph, one clause; I confirm the inventory. Ending: the amendment lives in the parent's section 1(a); the parent's own term, as replaced by Executive Order 12970, ended it on June 1, 1996 unless otherwise extended, and no held instrument extends it. Executive Order 13062 section 3(d), effective September 30, 1997, revokes the parent as amended by this order and is later. Original grade: Federal Register machine text. Searches: a by-number search of the held order texts for EO 12921 finds only this order's own Federal Register text (one match in one file); a plain text search of the held Federal Register files adds EO 13062 section 3(d), which lists Executive Orders 12890, 12921 and 12970 as amending the parent. EO 12970 does not contain the number 12921; it names only Executive Order No. 12864.
